d: An avian humanoid with a mature, regal presence and a slender, athletic build. The creature has a white feathered head topped with golden crests and purple accents, featuring sharp, narrow eyes. It wears a white and gold ornate chest piece with a gold belt and a long, flowing cape composed of white, yellow, and burnt orange feathers. The creature possesses bird-like talons and holds a long, golden staff with a decorative double-loop head. BODY COLOR: White and charcoal grey LEGS: Digitigrade with grey scaled skin and sharp white talons.
